verdict.rationale: The evidence shows durability building blocks rather than a documented durable-execution story. The SDK can pause and resume a run from the same RunState after approval interruptions, offers built-in session memory across runs, and supports resumable sandbox sessions. A community report also describes a durable Temporal version of the SDK examples that needs only minor workflow and activity changes. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a Temporal or other durable-execution integration, explicit evidence that RunState or sessions survive process restarts and deploys, and guidance on recovering long-lived agents mid-run.
